item.title: Fire Up the Fajitas, Agave Blue Cantina is Now Open in Arvada
item.description: When opening Agave Blue Cantina, chef Oscar Padilla wanted to offer something more homey than his other operation, and pay homage to his grandmother and traditional cantina cooking at the same time. He also aimed to launch the restaurant in a place where no other Mexican eatery has gone before.
